rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for issuing an official order or decree.

example.english: The government used its authority to ordain that all the city gates stay closed tonight.
example.traditional: 政府已經下令，今晚所有城門都唔准開。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ji5 ging1 haa6 ling6 gam1 maan1 so2 jau5 sing4 mun4 dou1 m4 zeon2 hoi1

rows.note: Use this for formally ordaining a Christian or Jewish religious official, such as a priest, bishop, minister, or rabbi.

example.english: The church formally chose to ordain Pastor Lee as a bishop today.
example.traditional: 教會今日正式按立李牧師做主教。
example.jyutping: gaau3 wui2 gam1 jat6 zing3 sik1 on3 laap6 lei5 muk6 si1 zou6 zyu2 gaau3

rows.note: Use this specifically when ordaining someone as a Buddhist monk through the traditional rite of shaving the head.

example.english: The master performed the rite to ordain him as a Buddhist monk today, and he has formally entered monastic life.
example.traditional: 師父今日幫佢剃度，佢正式出家喇。
example.jyutping: si1 fu2 gam1 jat6 bong1 keoi5 tai3 dou6 keoi5 zing3 sik1 ceot1 gaa1 laa3
